liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-04.148634.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 141 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The Senn ME 80 microphones provide a strong, full sound for this recording [25]
- **gd1985-11-04.132765.schoeps-oade.BCE.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1985-11-04.sbd.fix-shnid-7801.tetzeli.83072.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Jerry sounds terrible, while everyone else tries to keep the performance together [21]
- **gd1985-11-04.172446.nak701.blend.barnum.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 129 min [5]
- **gd1985-11-04.nak300.morris.106580.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [9]. Said about its sound: The audience recording is a little tinny in places, but the Terrapin is awesome [23]
- **gd1985-11-04.nak-beyer.tonys.79656.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: The Nak 100 pull sounds a bit bright, but the recording has warmth [20]

## Around the show

- The weather was cold and damp, with a parking lot scene that didn't help much [17]
- Bill Walton, Larry Bird, Kevin McHale, and Danny Ainge were on stage that night [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-04.148634.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [1]. Also: Michael Hessberg provided the master; Charlie Miller transferred it, using a Schoeps patch for Drums [1]
- **gd1985-11-04.132765.schoeps-oade.BCE.flac16**: taped by Doug Oade and Jim Wise; transferred by Dave Usborne; source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1; Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav; Recorded by the Oade Brothers; Mastering by Dave… [3]
- **gd1985-11-04.sbd.fix-shnid-7801.tetzeli.83072.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Pitch and patch fix of shnid 7801 [4]. Also: Pitch was adjusted -50 cents in Wavelab; a bridge was patched from Phil Unger's audience tape [4]
- **gd1985-11-04.172446.nak701.blend.barnum.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bruce Barnum; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bruce Barnum's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 701 (cardioid) mics x 3 > Nakamichi MX-100 mixer > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Bruce Barnum provided the master; Charlie Miller transferred it, using a Schoeps patch for Drums [5]
- **gd1985-11-04.nak300.morris.106580.flac16**: taped by Bob Morris; transferred by Bob Morris; source: Nakamichi CM-300 x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell XLII-S C-90) [9]
- **gd1985-11-04.nak-beyer.tonys.79656.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nakamichi CM304's + Beyer M101>Sony Mixer>Sony D5M [10]
